story_description: Provide pre-built hook templates that users can select, customize, and deploy without writing code from scratch, covering common security, testing, logging, context, and workflow patterns.
task_description: Create the HookTemplates Swift module with Template struct, TemplateCategory enum, and five built-in templates: securityFileProtection, securityCommandValidation, testEnforcement, contextLoader, and toolLogger.
atom: A001: Define Template Struct and TemplateCategory Enum with Built-in Templates
atom_description: Implement the HookTemplates enum containing the Template struct with id, name, description, category, event, matcher, hookType, content, and outputExample properties; the TemplateCategory enum with security, testing, logging, context, and workflow cases; and five static template instances covering file protection, command validation, test enforcement, context loading, and tool logging.
problem_statement: Users building hooks from scratch face a steep learning curve: they must understand hook events, output JSON schemas, matcher patterns, and security best practices. Without templates, users either create insecure hooks or avoid the feature entirely. Pre-built templates reduce friction and establish security baselines.
scope_in: Define Template struct with id, name, description, category, event, matcher, hookType, content, and outputExample properties
Define TemplateCategory enum with security, testing, logging, context, and workflow cases conforming to CaseIterable and Sendable
Implement securityFileProtection template blocking writes to sensitive paths and credentials files
Implement securityCommandValidation template blocking dangerous shell commands like rm -rf and curl pipe bash
Implement testEnforcement template ensuring tests run before agent stop after code changes
Implement contextLoader template loading CLAUDE.md and git context on session start
Implement toolLogger template logging all tool executions to JSONL trace file
Implement static all array containing all five templates
Implement templates(for:) filtering function by category
scope_out: Template persistence to disk or database
Custom user-defined templates beyond the five built-ins
Network-based template fetching from remote registry
assumptions: HookType enum exists with prompt and command cases
HookInput protocol exists for encoding test inputs

constraints: Template struct must conform to Identifiable and Sendable for SwiftUI compatibility
TemplateCategory enum must conform to CaseIterable for UI enumeration
All template content must be valid bash scripts or prompt strings
Command templates must output valid JSON matching hook output schema
All types must be public for use by settings UI module
functional_requirements: Template struct stores id as String identifier, name as display String, description as help text String, category as TemplateCategory, event as hook event String, matcher as pattern String, hookType as HookType enum, content as script or prompt String, and outputExample as sample JSON String

TemplateCategory enum provides five cases: security for access control hooks, testing for quality enforcement hooks, logging for audit trail hooks, context for session initialization hooks, and workflow for process automation hooks
securityFileProtection template targets PreToolUse event with Write or Edit matcher using prompt hookType to block writes to system directories, credentials files, and path traversal attempts
securityCommandValidation template targets PreToolUse event with Bash matcher using command hookType to block rm -rf on root paths, chmod 777, and curl piped to bash
testEnforcement template targets Stop event with wildcard matcher using prompt hookType to verify tests were run after code modifications
contextLoader template targets SessionStart event with startup matcher using command hookType to load CLAUDE.md content and recent git commits as system message
toolLogger template targets PostToolUse event with wildcard matcher using command hookType to append tool name, input, and result preview to JSONL trace file
Static all property returns array containing all five template instances in order
Static templates(for:) method filters all array by matching category parameter
nonfunctional_requirements: Template struct initialization must complete in under 1 millisecond as all values are compile-time constants
Memory footprint of all five templates must be under 50KB total
All templates must be thread-safe through Sendable conformance
Template content strings must be valid UTF-8 without control characters except newlines
implementation_steps: Create new file HookTemplates.swift in Blaze/Sources/Core/Hooks/ directory
Add Foundation import statement at file top
Define public enum HookTemplates as namespace container
Define nested public struct Template with Identifiable and Sendable conformance

Add nine public let properties to Template: id String, name String, description String, category TemplateCategory, event String, matcher String, hookType HookType, content String, outputExample String
Define nested public enum TemplateCategory with String raw value conforming to CaseIterable and Sendable
Add five cases to TemplateCategory: security, testing, logging, context, workflow with capitalized raw values
Define static let securityFileProtection with id security-file-protection, PreToolUse event, Write or Edit matcher, prompt hookType, and multi-line content verifying file path safety
Define static let securityCommandValidation with id security-command-validation, PreToolUse event, Bash matcher, command hookType, and bash script blocking dangerous patterns
Define static let testEnforcement with id test-enforcement, Stop event, wildcard matcher, prompt hookType, and content requiring test execution verification
Define static let contextLoader with id context-loader, SessionStart event, startup matcher, command hookType, and bash script loading project context
Define static let toolLogger with id tool-logger, PostToolUse event, wildcard matcher, command hookType, and bash script appending to trace file
Define static let all as array containing all five template constants in order
Define static func templates(for category: TemplateCategory) returning all.filter matching category

api_contracts: Template.id returns unique String identifier for the template
HookTemplates.all returns Array of Template containing all built-in templates
HookTemplates.templates(for:) returns filtered Array of Template matching the category parameter
event_contracts: securityFileProtection responds to PreToolUse events for Write and Edit tools
securityCommandValidation responds to PreToolUse events for Bash tool
testEnforcement responds to Stop events for all tools
contextLoader responds to SessionStart events with startup type
toolLogger responds to PostToolUse events for all tools
edge_cases: Empty templates(for:) result when called with category having no matching templates should return empty array without error
Template content containing single quotes must be properly escaped when passed to shell execution
Template content containing dollar signs must preserve variable expansion syntax
Long template descriptions exceeding UI display width must support truncation
Template outputExample containing nested JSON must be valid parseable JSON
failure_modes: HookType enum not defined in scope causes compilation error; mitigation is to ensure HookType.swift is compiled before HookTemplates.swift
Malformed bash script in command template causes runtime execution failure; mitigation is to validate scripts with shellcheck before inclusion
Invalid JSON in outputExample causes test parsing failure; mitigation is to validate all JSON literals at compile time
rollback_plan: Delete HookTemplates.swift file and remove any imports or references in other files. No database migrations or persistent state changes require rollback. Git revert of the commit restores previous state completely.

notes: This atom provides the foundation for the visual hook builder by supplying ready-to-use templates. Users can select a template and customize it rather than writing hooks from scratch. The five included templates cover the most common hook use cases identified from user research.

risks: Template bash scripts may contain shell injection vulnerabilities if user input is interpolated
Template content may become outdated as Claude Code hook API evolves
Hardcoded templates cannot be updated without app release
mitigations: All template scripts use jq for JSON parsing instead of string interpolation to prevent injection
Template content is versioned in source control with clear change history
Future atom will add remote template registry for dynamic updates
risk_register.blast_radius: Low - templates are optional convenience features; hook system works without them; no user data affected if templates malfunction
risk_register.fallback_plan: If templates cause issues, users can create hooks manually without templates; remove templates from UI picker while keeping hook builder functional

HookTemplates.templates(for: TemplateCategory) -> [Template] - filters templates by category
